provenance.note: Mumbai's rivers and lakes basin atlas (scope mumbai-rivers; the city's own scope id 'mumbai' is the MMR region). Catchment joins (shedId) come from sub-hydrosheds.geojson, whose city half is the reviewed pipeline input pipeline-inputs/mumbai-river-catchments-fabdem.geojson (FABDEM + WhiteboxTools); CPCB stretch and station figures are read from the reviewed national table pipeline-inputs/atlas/prs/cpcb-2025.json. FABDEM lineage makes the catchment-joined families CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial) encumbered.

properties.name: Malad STP
properties.details: 280 MLD plant discharging to Malad Creek. Effectively non-functional as a treatment works: 2023 outlet BOD 140.6 mg/l against an inlet of 144.2 - i.e. almost no treatment - and 99.4 in 2024, far above the 10 mg/l discharge standard. A 454 MLD replacement is proposed.

properties.name: Versova STP
properties.details: 180 MLD plant. Outlet BOD 53.4 (2023) and 58.1 (2024) mg/l against inlet ~143-146 - well above the 10 mg/l standard. A 180 MLD next-generation plant is proposed.
properties.replacement: Versova WWTF - 180 MLD next-generation plant - due 2026-07-04, status slipped (BMC ESR 2024-25)

properties.name: Ghatkopar STP
properties.details: 386 MLD plant discharging toward Thane Creek. Outlet BOD 38.0 (2023) and 24.5 (2024) mg/l - above the 10 mg/l standard. A 337 MLD replacement is proposed.
properties.replacement: Ghatkopar WWTF - 337 MLD next-generation plant - due 2026-07-04, status slipped (BMC ESR 2024-25)

properties.name: Bhandup STP
properties.details: 280 MLD plant discharging toward Thane Creek. Outlet BOD 30.4 (2023) and 20.7 (2024) mg/l - above the 10 mg/l standard. A 215 MLD replacement is proposed.
properties.replacement: Bhandup WWTF - 215 MLD next-generation plant - due 2026-08-22, status slipped (BMC ESR 2024-25)

properties.name: Worli STP (Love Grove)
properties.details: 757 MLD - Mumbai's largest STP, discharging via the Worli outfall. Compliant: outlet BOD ~1.9 mg/l (2023) against inlet ~124. A 500 MLD next-generation plant is proposed. Offline in 2024 for MSDP-2 reconstruction (500 MLD next-generation plant).

properties.name: Bandra STP (Bandra/Mahim influent)
properties.details: 797 MLD influent works discharging to Mahim Bay. Compliant: outlet BOD ~2.1 mg/l (2023) against inlet ~81-116. A 360 MLD next-generation plant is proposed. Offline in 2024 for MSDP-2 reconstruction (360 MLD next-generation plant).

properties.name: Colaba STP
properties.details: 41 MLD plant. Compliant: outlet BOD 1.3 (2023), 5.0 (2024) mg/l against inlet ~121-131.

properties.name: Charkop STP
properties.details: 6 MLD plant near Marve Creek. Compliant despite very high inlet load: outlet BOD ~3.1 (2023), 5.4 (2024) mg/l against inlet 181-214.

properties.name: Powai WSP (waste stabilisation pond)
properties.details: 8 MLD waste-stabilisation pond near Powai, at the head of the Mithi catchment. Small relative to the ~18 MLD of untreated sewage entering Powai Lake.

properties.name: Kopri STP (Thane)
properties.details: TMC's sewage treatment works at Kopri, on the western shore of Thane Creek - the receiving water for much of the eastern corridor's sewage (a 2025 review estimated ~1,260 MLD of domestic sewage reaching the creek, with BOD above the CPCB limit in all samples). Per-STP inlet/outlet performance is not published in a Praja-equivalent series.
properties.source: OpenStreetMap (location); Thane Creek WQ review 2025 (creek sewage load)

properties.name: NMMC STP (Koparkhairane side)
properties.details: One node of NMMC's sewage-treatment network discharging treated effluent toward Thane Creek. Navi Mumbai reports among the higher treatment coverage in the MMR (a multi-plant network of roughly 450 MLD installed). Per-STP BOD performance is not in a public RTI series.

properties.name: NMMC STP (Vashi/Nerul side)
properties.details: A southern node of NMMC's STP network discharging toward Thane Creek, part of the roughly 450 MLD installed across Navi Mumbai's plants.

properties.name: Mumbra WWTP (Thane)
properties.details: Wastewater works at Mumbra, on the Kalwa/Ulhas side of the eastern corridor where the Ulhas system meets Thane Creek. Per-STP performance is not publicly reported.

properties.name: Taloja WWTP (Panvel node)
properties.details: Wastewater plant at the Taloja node south-east of Navi Mumbai. The adjoining Taloja MIDC industrial cluster discharges to the Kasadi river, a documented MPCB/CPCB pollution concern, making this a mixed domestic + industrial pressure point on the eastern fringe.
properties.source: OpenStreetMap (location); MPCB/CPCB Kasadi river pollution record
